schema.text: If you were given free access to a shared bicycle or e-scooter, would you use it?

en.#If you were given free access to a shar: If you were given free access to a shared bicycle or e-scooter, would you use it?

it.#If you were given free access to a shar: Se avessi accesso gratuito a una bicicletta condivisa o a un monopattino elettrico, lo utilizzeresti?

fr.#If you were given free access to a shar: Si vous aviez gratuitement accès à un vélo partagé ou à une trottinette électrique, l’utiliseriez-vous ?

de.#If you were given free access to a shar: Wenn Sie kostenlos ein Leihrad oder einen E-Scooter nutzen könnten, würden Sie das tun?

tr.#If you were given free access to a shar: Paylaşımlı bir bisiklet veya e-scooter’ı ücretsiz kullanabilseydiniz kullanır mıydınız?

fa.#If you were given free access to a shar: اگر امکان استفاده رایگان از دوچرخه اشتراکی یا اسکوتر برقی را داشتید، از آن استفاده می‌کردید؟

hu.#If you were given free access to a shar: Ha ingyenesen használhatna közösségi kerékpárt vagy elektromos rollert, használná?

ar.#If you were given free access to a shar: إذا كان بإمكانك استخدام دراجة مشتركة أو سكوتر كهربائي مجانًا، هل ستستخدمه؟
